Check base dependencies

Source: R/check_base_deps.R
check_base_deps.Rd

Check base dependencies

Usage

check_base_deps(path = ".")

Arguments

path

character string containing a valid path to the folder with the package of which the DESCRIPTION file should be checked. The default is the working directory.

Value

A data frame with the dependencies on R, base packages and recommended packages as listed in the DESCRIPTION file, returned invisibly. A zero-row data frame is returned if such dependencies are not present.

The data frame has the following columns:

  • type giving the type of dependency, e.g., Imports, Depends, Suggests

  • package giving the package name or "R"

  • version giving the version specification, e.g., ">= 4.0.0", with * if no version is declared

Details

Package base should not be listed in the DESCRIPTION file: it is always loaded. See the Examples how to list a dependency on R using usethis::use_package().

A package can occur more than once within a single type of dependency (e.g., Imports, Depends, Suggests) to indicate a range, e.g., <pkg A> (>= 3.6.0) and <pkg A> (<= 4.4.0). However, each package should be listed in only one of the types of dependencies, otherwise an error is thrown.

It is not required to declare version numbers for the base or recommended packages. If version numbers are declared, they should contain at least a major and minor level. Warnings are issued if different minimum versions are declared for those packages, or if they declare minimum versions that differ from the declared earliest version of R if that is present.

If "R" is listed in the DESCRIPTION file, it should:

  • be in field "Depends"

  • declare at least one minimum version number

  • not declare a version earlier than any declared minimum versions of the base or recommended packages

  • contain at least a major and minor level, e.g., R (>= 4.0) or R (>= 4.1)

  • use 0 as patch level (i.e., as third digit in the version number) if it is present: R (>= 4.4.0) or R (>= 4.4) instead of R (>= 4.4.1), otherwise a warning is issued.

Examples

if(requireNamespace("withr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tempdir_example <- progutils::create_tempdir(
    prefix = "check_base_deps")

  withr::with_dir(new = tempdir_example, {
    # Create a DESCRIPTION file
    desc <- desc::description$new("!new")
    desc$write(file = fs::path(tempdir_example, "DESCRIPTION"))

    # Use package 'usethis' to add R with
    # a minimum version in 'Depends'
    if(requireNamespace("usethis", quietly = TRUE)) {
      usethis::use_package(
        "R", type = "Depends", min_version = "4.0.0")
      (check_base_deps(tempdir_example))
    }

    # Create a new DESCRIPTION file
    desc <- desc::description$new("!new")
    desc$write(file = fs::path(tempdir_example, "DESCRIPTION"))

    # Use package 'desc' to add R with
    # a minimum version in 'Depends'
    desc <- desc::desc_set_dep(
      "R", type = "Depends", version = ">= 4.0.0")
    (check_base_deps(tempdir_example))

    # Add package 'checkinput'
    desc <- desc::desc_set_dep("checkinput", type = "Depends")
    # 'checkinput' is not among the returned packages
    # because it is not a 'base' or 'recommended' package.
    (check_base_deps(tempdir_example))

    # Add package 'tools' (a 'base' package)
    # with an earlier minimum version than 'R'
    desc <- desc::desc_set_dep(
      "tools", type = "Depends", version = ">= 3.6.0")
    (check_base_deps(tempdir_example)) # silent

    # Add package 'utils' (a 'base' package)
    # with a later minimum version than 'R'
    desc <- desc::desc_set_dep(
      "utils", type = "Depends", version = ">= 4.1.0")
    # An error that the declared minimum version of R is
    # earlier than the declared minimum version of 'utils':
    try(check_base_deps(tempdir_example))

    # A new DESCRIPTION file without dependencies
    desc <- desc::description$new("!new")
    desc$write(file = fs::path(tempdir_example, "DESCRIPTION"))
    # Silently returns a zero-row data frame
    (check_base_deps(tempdir_example))

    # R without minimum version in 'Depends'
    desc <- desc::description$new("!new")
    desc$write(file = fs::path(tempdir_example, "DESCRIPTION"))
    desc <- desc::desc_set_dep("R", type = "Depends")
    try(check_base_deps(tempdir_example)) # Error
  })

  # Remove temporary directory
  unlink(tempdir_example, recursive = TRUE)
}
